description: This file defines a PHP class ADODB_Cache_MemCache for handling memory caching with Memcache and Memcached extensions within the ADOdb database abstraction layer. It includes methods for connecting, reading, writing, and flushing cache entries, and manages external dependencies and configuration options.

classes.name: ADODB_Cache_MemCache
classes.description: A class for managing memory cache operations using Memcache or Memcached extensions in PHP, including connection handling, cache read/write, and cache flush functionalities.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a lazy connection to the memcache server, selecting the appropriate library and configuring server controllers.

methods.name: writeCache
methods.description: Stores data in the memcache server with a specified expiration time.

methods.name: readCache
methods.description: Retrieves cached data from the memcache server, unserializing and validating it.

methods.name: flushAll
methods.description: Flushes all cached data from the memcache server.

methods.name: flushCache
methods.description: Deletes a specific cache entry identified by its filename (MD5 hash).
